title: Seismic hazard zone V – Pithoragarh
subject: Environment
caption: Seismic hazard zone V across India with emphasis on Pithoragarh, Uttarakhand.
altText: A white‑background map of India displaying seismic hazard zones; zone V is colored bright red along the northern Himalayas. An inset map zooms into Uttarakhand, highlighting Pithoragarh district with its borders and a red dot marking the town of Pithoragarh. A legend explains the zone colors, and a scale bar and north arrow are included. All features are clearly labelled for educational purposes.
